content.doc_md:
The easiest way to play videos in HTML, is to use YouTube.

Converting videos to different formats can be difficult and time-consuming.

An easier solution is to let YouTube play the videos in your web page.

YouTube will display an id (like tgbNymZ7vqY), when you save (or play) a video.

You can use this id, and refer to your video in the HTML code.

To play your video on a web page, do the following:

You can let your video start playing automatically when a user visits the 
page, by addingautoplay=1to the YouTube URL. 
However, automatically starting a video is annoying for your visitors!

Addmute=1afterautoplay=1to let your video start playing automatically (but muted).

A comma separated list of videos to play (in addition to the original URL).

Addplaylist=videoIDandloop=1to let your video loop forever.

loop=0(default) - The video will play only once.

loop=1- The video will loop (forever).

Addcontrols=0to NOT display controls in the 
video player.

controls=0- Player controls does not display.

controls=1(default) - Player controls is displayed.

### Code Snippets

```
<iframe width="420" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/tgbNymZ7vqY">
</iframe>

---

<iframe width="420" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/tgbNymZ7vqY?autoplay=1&mute=1">
</iframe>

---

<iframe width="420" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/tgbNymZ7vqY?playlist=tgbNymZ7vqY&loop=1">
</iframe>

---

<iframe width="420" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/tgbNymZ7vqY?controls=0">
</iframe>
```
